As on 31/2/1 the parity INVERTS at the end: idx 29 is the Hindi of Q39(a)(ii)(II) + Q39(b) (confirmed at full size) and idx 30 is ENGLISH-ONLY (the solenoid figure with Q39(a)(ii)(II), OR, Q39(b) with its circuit), confirmed at full size. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Sections by discipline as instruction (ii) prints: A Biology Q1-16 (30), B Chemistry Q17-29 (25), C Physics Q30-39 (25). LAYOUT DISAGREES WITH sci80_2026 in ONE place: this set prints the 5-mark long answer as Q15 and the 4-mark case study as Q16 (the opener and all four other 2026 openers print the case study as Q15 and the long answer as Q16). Confirmed on the paper (idx 10 prints Q15 at 2+2+1=5, idx 12 prints Q16's passage with parts 1/1/2/2) and on the scheme (Q15 total 5, Q16 total 4). Rows carry the PRINTED marks, so validate.ts reports Q16's four case-study parts against the 5-mark band; lib.ts is not mine to edit. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 0-10, every footer reads 31/2/2) for a bare OR: Q10, Q15, Q16(c), Q27, Q28(c), Q29, Q34, Q38(c), Q39 = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper.
